chapter_title: [Concerning the Advent of Five Fathers from the Five Limbs of the Father]
chapter_note: This chapter is dominated by a compact five-fold correspondential mapping: five divine/cosmic hypostases are said to “come from” five internal faculties/limbs of the Father (mind, thought, insight, counsel, consideration). ¶1 is a later dialogue/frame header (“the apostle speaks”); ¶2–¶3 read as impersonal, systematic cosmological exposition with no institutional or Gospel anchoring.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic hagiographic opening and dialogue attribution (“Once again the apostle speaks… He speaks thus:”). ‘Apostle’ is a compilation-frame marker rather than substrate exposition.

paragraphs.core_text: The [Ambas]sador [came] from his mind; the Beloved of the Lights [from his thought]; the Mother of Life from his insight; [Jesus] the Beloved from his counsel; the Virgin of Lig[ht f]rom his consideration.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Five-fold, degree-like mapping entirely within the cosmic system: hypostasis → internal faculty/limb of the Father. No citation formula, no exhortation, no institutional referent; ‘[Jesus] the Beloved’ functions here as a named cosmic being within the hierarchy, not a Gospel overlay.

paragraphs.core_text: So in this way were summone[d these five] fathers. These five advents came from the five limbs [of the Father]. One came from another and was manifested in its season.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the same impersonal, structural exposition: reiterates the five-limbs origin and gives a process statement (“manifested in its season”) rather than applying it to a community or ethical instruction.
